facts.fact: ATC Uganda paid UGX 20.9 billion to the Uganda Communications Commission as its statutory 2% of gross annual revenue under the Uganda Communications Act, 2013, to finance UCUSAF; the UCC Executive Director said half goes to the Consolidated Fund and half is retained by UCC for UCUSAF; no event date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: UCUSAF (Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund)
